title: Invariant Discovery for Networked Systems
abstract: arXiv:2607.22944v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Invariants, the relations expected to hold among measured signals of a network, underpin applications from verification to traffic generation, telemetry imputation, and input validation. Yet, writing them by hand demands rare expertise in both formal logic and networking. Testing all possible combinations of telemetry variables statistically is intractable at network scale, while existing automatic tools still require a human-authored grammar of admissible invariants and learn only exact, "hard" rules that break under real-world noise. Our key idea is to use an LLM to inspect variable metadata, classify counter data types, and predict candidate syntactic relationships that form a compact grammar, followed by a deterministic statistical search within that grammar. If the initial grammar fails to recover trusted known invariants on held-out telemetry, Autogram instructs the LLM to iteratively widen the grammar until recovery succ

translated_title: 面向网络化系统的不变量发现
translated_abstract: 不变量是指网络中各测量信号之间预期成立的关系，它是从验证、流量生成、遥测数据填补到输入校验等众多应用的基础。然而，手工编写这些不变量需要同时具备形式逻辑与网络领域的稀缺专业知识。在网络规模下，对所有遥测变量的可能组合进行统计检验是难以实现的；而现有的自动化工具仍然需要人工编写可接受不变量的文法，并且只能学习精确的、“硬性”的规则，这类规则在真实世界的噪声下会失效。我们的核心思路是利用大语言模型（LLM）检查变量元数据、对计数器数据类型进行分类，并预测候选的句法关系以形成一个紧凑的文法，然后在该文法内进行确定性的统计搜索。如果初始文法无法在留出的遥测数据上恢复出可信的已知不变量，Autogram 会指示 LLM 迭代地扩展文法，直至恢复成功。
tldr: 本文提出 Autogram，通过让 LLM 生成紧凑的候选不变量文法并在其内进行确定性统计搜索、再迭代扩展文法直至恢复已知可信不变量，实现了无需人工文法且能容忍真实噪声的网络系统不变量自动发现。
en_tdlr: Autogram leverages an LLM to construct a compact grammar of candidate invariants, performs deterministic statistical search within it, and iteratively widens the grammar until trusted invariants are recovered, enabling automatic, noise-tolerant invariant discovery for networked systems without manual grammars.
